questions.question: She _______ (go) to school every day, but she stays home today because she’s sick.
_______ (the) apples in the basket are ripe. They look very sweet.
They _______ (play) football in the park on Saturdays. It’s their favourite activity.
_______ (I/you) know her? She looks familiar, but I’m not sure.
He _______ (finish) his homework before dinner. He’s always organised.
_______ (the) water in this glass is cold. It’s perfect for a hot day.
They _______ (live) in London for five years, but they’re moving to Manchester next month.
_______ (She/he) going to the cinema tomorrow? I wonder if she’ll bring her friends.
We _______ (not eat) meat on Fridays because we follow a vegetarian diet.
_______ (This) is my favourite book. It’s written by an amazing author.
